bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 4, 6. GRAFTON STREET begins his Australian career today at start number two after trialing twice last month at Randwick. He is suitably placed in this class and unlike some, he can be expected to cope over this distance first up. PIERRO LAD dug deep to open his account second up at Kembla Grange and immediately taking the next step isn't beyond him here. DON'S PARTY handed in quick late sectionals to score when he was resuming at Wyong with Andrew Calder aboard. He should have more to offer with Andrew retaining the ride today. FIREWORK wasn't disgraced in a race that wasn't run to suit him third up at Newcastle. He did however indicate that stepping up from 1200m can be regarded already as a plus.

raceTips.comment: Grafton Street sparks plenty of interest resuming for a second preparation. Rachel King has been aboard in both trials leading in and sticks on here. Pierro Lad has the benefit of race day fitness and is coming off a last start win when well supported. Don's Party won his last start with ease and was drawing clear through the line suggesting the distance rise here would suit. Vasala strips fitter third up and sets up for a soft lead which can see him in this for a long way.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 4, 6, 8. RAPID REVENUE became unsuited on the Kensington track on debut before he's handed in solid efforts as his distances have increased twice at Kembla Grange. He can again make his presence felt when he tackles another distance rise this afternoon. BUONGIORNO presents on debut after trialing on three occasions since a spell. He should not be doubted over this testing journey at his first run in a race. ROULADEN must be forgiven for a Kembla Grange defeat last start after he struck traffic problems. He has scope to improve today at start number two in blinkers. BLAZING FUTURE raced greenly here when he tackled this distance second up. The addition of blinkers is expected to aid his cause this afternoon.

raceTips.comment: Rapid Revenue covered ground last time but still stick on gallantly for a minor money spot. We get a gauge on that form via Pierro Lad in race one. He looks deserving of favouritism. Rouladen is hard-fit now after three consecutive seconds and sets up as the map horse of the race. Copartner Pegasus looks the leader and can be in this for a long way if given an easy time of things. Buongiorno has been well educated by way of trials and looks suited kicking straight off over this distance range.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 6, 8, 9, 10. FARFETCHED was responsible for a solid effort over 1200m at Canterbury with Rachel King aboard. Stepping up to tackle this trip should now aid her cause with Rachel retaining the ride. ADAPTATION struck traffic problems first up at Canterbury and his unplaced effort must be forgiven when he presents race-fitter today. KISS OF GOLD stuck to his task in defeat on the Illawarra Grange track last start and a step up form 1150m now aids her cause. GAULTIER is resuming from a very long spell after trialing twice last month at his Rosehill home base. He can be expected to cope over this journey first up.

raceTips.comment: Farfetched is hard-fit at this point of the prep and goes around 3kg lighter than last start. Rachel King sticks on, I dare say she wouldn't have to improve much to be winning a race like this. Gaultier has trialled well and was good in her debut run last prep, but it must be noted that was prior to a long spell which is of some concern. Adaptation drifted notably when resuming but was solid. All the fitter now. Written About showed ability in her initial campaign and has been readied with a handful of trials.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 4, 5, 9, 10. WAEREA did all but win first up at Wyong. He returns to his home base today when he will present race-fitter at his second start as a gelding. DUBAI ADVENTURE was competing for the first time since a stable change when there were excuses first up on the Illawarra Grange track last start. He clearly has scope to improve. GALACTIC FORCE performed well above market place expectations last start at Wyong. He was a winner when he was last produced here, over this distance and he can maintain his form today. HARD JAKKA finished unplaced in this class on the Illawarra Grange track last start but numerous gear changes have now been made and he should appreciate the distance rise that now awaits him.

raceTips.comment: Waerea did everything but win when resuming notching up yet another second placing. He has strong form lines and so much upside I think he simply wins this and justifies the quote. Dubai Adventure had a bad habit of slow getaways but showed a good turn of foot when resuming for the new stable. More ground suits. Galactic Force ran much better than pricing suggested last start. Hard Jakka is at peak fitness and maps to lead.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 3, 5, 6, 9. HIGHBORN HARRY kept trying in defeat after he had raced keenly in transit last start at Goulburn. A gear change has now been made and he does have scope to improve. LUGARNO shouldn't be harshly judged for his unplaced Wyong first up effort when he was anything but disgraced at Wyong. He can already appreciate the significant distance rise that now awaits him. VIEWPOINT didn't threaten on a heavy Randwick surface last start. He is however more suitably placed this afternoon where he has won twice from three attempts at Hawkesbury. THE IRON STAR must be forgiven for an unplaced latest Randwick performance after he became most unsuited. He can sharply improve when he returns to his home base today.

raceTips.comment: Concede it's been a while between wins for Highborn Harry but this looks a suitable assignment to change that. Hopefully he can jump away cleaner than his last two starts. Viewpoint got too far back in running last time. Drops in class here and from the inside draw should settle much closer. The Iron Star ran on well to score at track/trip two back before contesting a stronger race last time. Has been freshened since and looks well placed back in this grade. Inception next.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8. UNION began his second campaign last start when he kept trying in defeat after he endured a tough run in transit at Kembla Grange. He will have scope to improve when he now makes a Hawkesbury debut. MAYWEATHER was spelled after there were excuses for an unplaced effort at Newcastle. He resumes from a very, very long spell today as a gelding for the first time and after trialing on numerous occasions. He shouldn't be underestimated. GAULTIER was a dual acceptor for this meeting. He is resuming from a long spell after trialing twice at his Rosehill home base and he should be treated with respect in whichever race is eventually contests. VAIN TEMPTRESS presents on debut. She has been given two well spaced trials and this journey should be ideal at her first start.

raceTips.comment: Legaselli appeals at the price. Resumes for a second prep off a trial win. She contested stakes races throughout her first prep so the stable clearly have an opinion. Mayweather resumes gelded off a very long spell and has three trials in July to prepare. He has already been subject to good market support which should be noted. Union was caught wide when resuming so add merit to the effort. Fitter now and draws for a much more economical run. Gaultier is in earlier on the program but does gain a start here. Respectful of whatever option the stable chooses.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 4, 5, 7, 8. CASTLEJOHN was spelled after there were excuses for a costly unplaced effort at his Warwick Farm home base. He now resumes after trialing twice at home and making a provincial debut will aid his cause today at only his third run in a race. SPRIGHTLY AFFAIR scored with great authority when she was resuming at Newcastle and stepping up from only 900m already aids her cause. MAIDOFF handed in a game first up effort last preparation at his Warwick Farm home base and after trialing twice recently at home, another strong performance can be expected from him first up when he now makes a Hawkesbury debut. DIRTY SUMMER begins his third campaign today with a gear change made and after trialing twice last month at his Randwick home base. He can be expected to fire first up, aided by the claim for Deon Le Roux.

raceTips.comment: Castlejohn resumes for a second prep after having shown good ability last time in amongst handy horses. Looks the clear horse to beat and that is reflective in the market. Sprightly Affair comes off a resuming win and has upside being so lightly raced. Dirty Summer resumes off a trial win, gets good weight relief with a claimer on and sets up for a cushy run. Nymphadora next.
